CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Hiding stolen items

2. Which response best shows understanding of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Use Methods of Studying the Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Methods of Studying the Holy Bible.
   C. Say Methods of Studying the Holy Bible has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Principles of Good Stewardship? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Principles of Good Stewardship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Principles of Good Stewardship has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Principles of Good Stewardship.
   D. Use Principles of Good Stewardship to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Prophet Jeremiah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Prophet Jeremiah has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Prophet Jeremiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Prophet Jeremiah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophet Jeremiah.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Judges? (1 mark)

   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Judges.

6. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Waste food daily

7. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation.
   D. Use Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem? (1 mark)
   A. Say Journey to Jerusalem has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Journey to Jerusalem to insult classmates of other faiths.

   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem.

   A. Say Journey to Jerusalem: has no place in daily life.

   C. Use Writing the Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Writing the Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

15. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
